full_judgment: 2. The facts, relevant for disposal of this petition, are that the plaintiff, Girin Ghosh (now deceased), predecessor of the present respondents, filed Land Survey Tribunal Case No.1268 of 2010 for correction of the record of rights of land measuring 8.50 decimals under Dhaka City Survey Khatian No.693, Plot No.9308 on 05.05.20 0, stating, inter alia, that land measuring 2.08 acres appertaining to CS Plot No. 177, Mouza No.297 Begunbari, Police Station-Tejgaon, presently Tejgaon Industrial Area, Dhaka originally belonged to Brojonath Dhupi. which later devolved on his son, Sharat Chandra Dhupi who transferred 1.25 acres land out of 2.08 acres land to Madlona Di Rozario vide registered deed dated 12.06.1950 and after the death of Madloan Di Roziario, her heirs inherited the said land. Subsequently, one Shakhawat Hossain purchased 8.50 decimals land from the heirs of Madlona Di Rozario on 03.12.1988 and accordingly, the land was mutated in his name in 1990. On 25.03.1999, the said land was sold out to the plaintiff, Girin Ghosh and accordingly, the mutation khatian was prepared in his name. The plaintiff established a motor car show room thereon and also by mortgaging the same obtained loan from Janata Bank Limited. Earlier the Government acquired the said land from Madlona Di Rozario on 03.03.1957 and subsequently, derequisitioned the said land in favour of Madlona Di Rozario on 09.07.1962. Thus, the land was enlisted as vested property and at the instance of Madlona Di Rozario, the Government by notice dated 17.12.1989 informed that the land was released from the list of vested property. At the time of City Survey, the khatian of the land was wrongly prepared in the name of Bangladesh Railway, instead of the name of plaintiff, Girin Ghosh; hence the case.
